methods.name: Regression adjustment (OLS outcome model per arm) ATE/ATT with the stacked-equation sandwich SE; doubly robust IPW with the M-estimation SE
methods.reference: stats::lm per arm; regression adjustment over all / treated units; stacked estimating-equation sandwich (HC0, trimming fixed) written out; equal to the fully interacted lm's standardised contrast. DR-IPW: WeightIt lm_weightit vcov = 'asympt' (case ipw_aipw_sim)
quantities: DR-IPW Hajek ATE/ATT and M-estimation SE

methods.name: IPW causal mediation (Huber 2014): theta(0), delta(1), theta(1), delta(0) and the total effect
methods.reference: Huber (2014) normalised IPW weights with glm(binomial) propensities p(X), p(M, X), as causalweight::medweight's effects (written out; causalweight not installed); p2a's trimming rule
methods.tolerance: Tol::iterative(1e-8): p2a's propensity fits stop at the GLM default, R's at epsilon 1e-14

methods.name: Regression standardisation SEs: delta method and stacked-equation sandwich for E[Y(1)], E[Y(0)] and ATE/ATT/ATC

quantities: E[Y(1)], E[Y(0)], effect for lm, lm with A x W, logit, logit with A x W, Poisson over all / treated / controls
